name: GPU-Accelerated Metaball Isosurface Generation
definition: A two-stage GPU pipeline to generate an isosurface from a combined field of metaballs, utilizing vertex shaders for field evaluation and geometry shaders for mesh generation, with results cached via Transform-Feedback to avoid recomputation during camera movement.
summary: GPU-Accelerated Metaball Isosurface Generation uses a two-stage GPU pipeline with Transform-Feedback caching to separate field computation from mesh generation, avoiding redundant geometry recalculation during camera movement.
